method: Actual released app screens rendered with a simulator-only display fixture. The Sui QR encodes a deliberately invalid demonstration string. No accounts were funded and no transaction was signed.

images.name: sui
images.alt: Oath Receive Sui Network screen with a demo QR, Copy address and Share buttons
images.caption: This real app screen uses an invalid demonstration address. Use Copy address in your own wallet or show its QR code to your sender.

images.name: trx
images.alt: Native TRX asset screen in Oath showing Send, Receive and example TRX activity
images.caption: The native TRX screen labels amounts in TRX. Balances, prices and activity are mock data.

images.name: txnx
images.alt: Texas Instruments xStock asset detail in Oath for the Ethereum catalog entry, with mock TXNX activity
images.caption: Ethereum entry selected for this capture. TXNX is the released catalog spelling. The displayed balance, price and history are mock data, independent of the market price.
